field_rationale.one: After fern at INFO the front handler is below its WARNING threshold. No target call occurs.
field_rationale.two: Elm equals the front threshold, causing ordered forwarding to mid.handle. Both INFO and WARNING lie below mid’s ERROR threshold and both stay pending there.
field_rationale.three: CRITICAL exceeds both WARNING and ERROR. The front flush forwards oak, and mid’s flush forwards its two retained entries and oak to the tap.

field_rationale.predicates: Direct shouldFlush uses the supplied record and current empty occupancy, bypassing the source filter. Relative to INFO, ERROR and WARNING pass and DEBUG does not.
field_rationale.first: The filter supplies xi. Its DEBUG level keeps it pending, and handle returns that accepted replacement record.
field_rationale.second: The replacement psi is WARNING, reaching the INFO threshold. It causes ordered delivery of xi then psi; handle returns psi.

field_rationale.first_result: Left handles i and switches to Right. The next call reaches Right.handle(j), which raises ValueError. The exception escapes the original flush.
field_rationale.first_state: Reentrant setTarget changes the installed reference. Right records the j attempt before failing. Only Left stores a record; the buffer clear has not run.
field_rationale.retry: A fresh flush starts at i using the already installed Right. The one-time error is disarmed, so Right handles all three and the batch clears.

flushOnClose defaults to true and is stored.
Optionally flush; detach the target and invoke BufferingHandler.close in finally, with no closed guard.
Parent close invokes the dynamic flush method and calls Handler.close in finally.
Base close marks closed; it does not prevent later direct handler methods.

field_rationale.first_close: Default close flushes while the target is initially truthy. The loop reads self.target but does not retest truth for moon. Close detaches it. No sink flush or close is invoked.
field_rationale.intervening: The closed handler accepts direct setTarget and emit. The star record stays present after explicit flush because the target is now falsy.
field_rationale.second_close: The next close performs its optional initial flush again. The relit target receives star and switches itself off. Successful delivery clears the buffer and close detaches the target.

field_rationale.returns: Each source filter result is the shared LogRecord and becomes the return value of its handle call.
field_rationale.pending: emit appends one reference per accepted call. Both entries are references to the same shared record, at occupancy two below capacity.
field_rationale.seen: The explicit flush forwards the same live object twice. Its second call sees the first mutation. Returning False causes no early exit; both mutations persist and the buffer clears.

field_rationale.first_result: Appending p reaches capacity and immediately invokes flush. The OSError on p propagates out of the originating handle.
field_rationale.after_first: Both n and p are retained after the failed flush; only n was accepted. The tap attempted both in that order.
field_rationale.after_repeat: Repeating handle appends another reference to p before testing the already full buffer. The next flush restarts at n, accepts n,p,p and clears; cumulative delivery is n,n,p,p.
